paragraphs.text: Élan d'Avenant was an archer squire of the Order of the D'Avenant on Dominaria . To seal an alliance with the town of Hamath , she was to kill Jared Carthalion , who was believed to be a minion of Ravidel . However, before she could kill him, Kristina of the Woods took him away. Élan followed Jared and Kristina to the White Woods but was prevented from killing Jared when the tree she hid in shook due to Exarch Amadis ' magic during the battle against the Calthyn Elves , sending her to the ground. Jared accidentally summoned her during a duel with Ravidel, and the Battlemage incinerated her.
